decisions.statement: A proxy is read back only where its process key parses.
A proxy whose port is not a number is not read back.
A proxy whose version is empty or absent is not read back.
A process key held as null reads the same as a key that is not there.
Nothing is written where the agent has no seat name.
A pid whose start ticks will not read is written as a null process key.

definition: the oauth proxy a seat holds, written beside the seat and read back from akasha
